module Concurrency.StructuredScopeBlocks

type Invoice is record
    id: Integer
end record

type Customer is record
    id: Integer
end record

async function load_invoice(id: Integer) returns Invoice
is
    return Invoice { id: id }
end load_invoice

async function load_customer(id: Integer) returns Customer
is
    return Customer { id: id }
end load_customer

function render_invoice(invoice: Invoice, customer: Customer) returns Integer
is
    return invoice.id + customer.id
end render_invoice

async function handle(id: Integer) returns Integer
is
    scope request_scope do
        spawn
            let invoice_handle: JoinHandle<Invoice> = request_scope.spawn<Invoice>(load_invoice(id))
            let customer_handle: JoinHandle<Customer> = request_scope.spawn<Customer>(load_customer(id))
        join
            let invoice: Invoice = await request_scope.join<Invoice>(invoice_handle)
            let customer: Customer = await request_scope.join<Customer>(customer_handle)
        result
            return render_invoice(invoice, customer)
    end scope
end handle

end Concurrency.StructuredScopeBlocks
